notes: System Awake is now the main on/off control, replacing the separate Vesila switch; Presence requires System Awake to be on.
While System Awake is on, your display now stays awake as well as your Mac.
Redesigned the menu with clearer, clickable feature cards; options that need System Awake are dimmed until you turn it on.
Improved reliability with more robust automated testing and release checks.
Added Scheduled activation mode with configurable weekdays and start/end times directly in the menu bar.
Vesila now automatically evaluates your schedule when the app launches and when your Mac wakes or resumes.
Manual changes during a scheduled window now apply only to the current window, so the next scheduled window starts fresh.
Added a global Vesila activation toggle for easier control.
Improved Stay Active When Locked behavior.
Improved system state synchronization and reliability.
